decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-down today (NASDAQ -0.4%, S&P 500 -0.1%), a neutral session with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand is only $189.29, well below the $500 threshold needed to responsibly open a new position, so we held all 7 existing positions and made no new trades.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today, with the NASDAQ down 0.4% and the S&P 500 down 0.1%, reflecting a quiet, directionless session rather than any significant risk-off move. Without a clear catalyst pushing volume or volatility higher, institutional participation appeared light. This kind of low-conviction day is typically best spent holding existing positions rather than chasing new entries.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢平淡，納斯達克指數下跌0.4%，標普500指數下跌0.1%，顯示市場方向不明、交投清淡，並非明顯的risk-off訊號。由於缺乏明確的催化因素帶動成交量或波動率上升，機構參與度顯得偏低。在這種低信心度的交易日，通常較適合持有現有部位，而非追高進場。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off refers to a cautious market stance where investors avoid adding new exposure, often due to low cash reserves or unclear market direction rather than fear alone. Today, with cash below the $500 buying threshold and no strong bullish signal across the screened candidates, the disciplined move was to preserve capital and hold current positions instead of forcing a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: Risk-off（風險規避）指投資人採取謹慎態度、避免增加新部位的市場心態，原因不一定是恐慌，也可能是現金不足或市場方向不明。今日現金低於500美元的買入門檻，且篩選名單中沒有強烈的看漲訊號，因此紀律性的做法是保留資金、持有現有部位，而非勉強進場交易。
